source_verification.important_limit: Existence and broad concept alignment do not by themselves establish an exact semantic duplicate. source_verification.qualification: All referenced rows exist and match their recorded subject/topic and broad skill family. This does not convert a skill-family resemblance into an independently approved duplicate disposition; the pairs remain subject to contextual and qualified academic review.
